lemmas.primary_translation: to insert; to install; to put in; to give notice of; to report

definitions.text: montere (særlig noe teknisk eller et elektrisk anlegg)
definitions.translation: to install (especially something technical or an electrical system)
to place in or within something

examples.no: hun la inn snus i munnen
examples.en: she put snus in her mouth

examples.no: vi la inn resultatene i databasen
examples.en: we entered the results into the database

examples.no: de velger å legge inn en pause i studiene
examples.en: they choose to include a break in their studies

examples.no: legge inn bud på en leilighet
examples.en: place a bid on an apartment
